name: Soffit & Fascia Calculator
description: Estimate soffit area, fascia length, material quantity and waste allowance for roof eaves.
search_intent: Calculate soffit and fascia materials needed for a house or roof perimeter.
calculation: Soffit area = total eave length × soffit depth. Apply waste multiplier 1 + wastePercent/100. Soffit pieces = ceiling(soffit area with waste / soffit panel coverage). Fascia required length = eave length × waste multiplier. Fascia board count = ceiling(fascia required length / board length). Preserve user-selected units consistently.
limitations: Roof geometry, gables, returns and rake boards may require separate measurement.
Actual manufacturer panel coverage can differ.
Estimator only; verify field measurements before ordering.
